package.description: Make education more exciting with interaction.

en-US.description: Make education more exciting with interaction.
en-US.longDescription: SeewoIwbAssistant provides functions such as scanning QR codes to connect, taking photos to upload, and screen mirroring from mobile phones. You can use this software and the EasiNote app to pair your mobile with your PC, enabling communication between them. After scanning the QR code with EasiNote to connect to SeewoIwbAssistant, the assistant can help you conveniently mirror your phone screen to the desktop, control presentations on desktop, and use voice to control the computer.
en-US.name: 希沃课堂助手

zh-CN.longDescription: 课堂助手提供扫码连接、拍照上传、手机传屏等功能。您可以使用本软件和希沃白板 App 完成移动智能终端和 PC 终端配对，实现移动智能终端和 PC 终端相互通讯。通过希沃白板扫码与课堂助手连接后，课堂助手可支持您使用手机便捷地在电脑投屏、控制电脑 PPT、使用语音控制电脑。
zh-CN.name: 希沃课堂助手
